verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships GNOME Boxes, described as removing guesswork from VM creation by just selecting an OS, which directly supports quick VM creation without manual configuration. However, this is a single first-party marketing line with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the experience, no detail on automation depth, and no community evidence discussing Boxes specifically. Missing for 10: independent verification of Boxes' ease-of-use, details on supported guest OS automation, and any community feedback on the VM creation workflow.
